If you want to sell your Groww Overnight Fund Direct Growth holdings, go to your holding on the app or web and simply click on it. You will get two options - redeem & invest more; click on redeem and enter your desired amount or if you wish to redeem the entire holding amount then select the 'redeem all' checkbox.

You can select eitherSIPorLumpsuminvestment of Groww Overnight Fund Direct Growth based on your investment objective and risk tolerance.
